name: media.mux
title: Media mux
summary: Put an audio track onto a video without re-encoding the video: stream-copy the video and encode (or copy) the audio, with an optional audio delay.
description: Combines a video file and an audio file into one container. The video stream is always copied; the audio is encoded (aac, opus, mp3) or copied. Use an offset to delay audio and shortest to trim the result to the shorter stream.

video.description: Video source: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. Its first video stream is copied unchanged.

audio.description: Audio source: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. Its first audio stream is mapped.

audio_codec.description: Audio codec: aac, libopus or libmp3lame re-encode; copy passes the source audio through (use only when the container accepts it).

audio_bitrate_k.description: Audio bit rate in kbit/s when the audio is re-encoded; ignored for copy.

audio_sample_rate.description: Optional audio sample rate in Hz for re-encoding; omit to keep the source rate.

audio_offset_s.description: Seconds to delay the audio relative to the video (ffmpeg -itsoffset); 0 starts both together.

shortest.description: Stop at the shorter of the two streams (ffmpeg -shortest); set false to keep the longer one.

name.description: Output file name inside the job's out folder, e.g. video.mp4.

examples.title: Mux a tone onto a clip
